retryRecovery.providerFailureRecovery: All provider-failure screens in the dated queue were either completed from verified archive pages or completed through exact bounded retries.
retryRecovery.taxonomyDisposition: The remaining taxonomy screens require an approved catalog alias or accepted-name policy and were not sent back to the provider.

throughputSeparation.machine: The desktop sustained three acquisition lanes, two archive-processing lanes, and sequential MAIN integration without crossing the 3 GiB heavy-worker floor or producing page writes.
throughputSeparation.provider: Transient GBIF request and response-read failures required bounded retries. No HTTP 429 response was observed, and the remaining retry tail completed on the final exact request.
throughputSeparation.archiveReuse: Verified archive replay moved 15851 county-species pairs without a live provider request.

contradictionsPreserved: The dated checkpoint reported 19 retryable provider failures and 11 taxonomy ambiguities. Durable taxonomy review found 12 state-species screens across 8 unique catalog taxa because one ambiguous taxon affected five jurisdictions.

The restricted sandbox reported uv_os_get_passwd ENOMEM while Windows still had more than 12 GiB available. The same Node 22 commands succeeded outside that sandbox, so this was not treated as physical-memory exhaustion.
One Georgia archive run was scientifically complete but rejected at 1241 MiB against a 1024 MiB lease. Its 2048 MiB replacement replay was validated and integrated without reacquisition.

A Georgia retry produced a discarded partial result before later attempts exhausted a 1024 MiB lease. The truthful failed bundle was preserved, and a corrected 1536 MiB replacement completed all 795 pairs.

A Connecticut retry preserved nine incomplete pairs after a response-read failure, and the first replacement preserved the same nine pairs after a provider request failure. A final exact replacement completed all nine pairs without negative inference from either failed request.
The machine had capacity for more lanes at several samples, but only three worker-agent slots were available alongside MAIN.
